description.en: The ID of the file system.

description.zh:
分页查询时当前的页码。

起始值（默认值）：1
description.en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页的行数。

取值范围：1~100

默认值：10
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.

description.zh:
任务状态。取值：

- Running：运行中
- Defragmenting：数据整理中
- PartialSuccess：部分运行成功
- Success：运行成功
- Fail：运行失败
- Cancelled：已取消
- All（默认值）：全部
description.en:
The job status. Valid values:

*   Running: The job is running.
*   Defragmenting: The job is defragmenting data.
*   PartialSuccess: The job is partially completed.
*   Success: The job is completed.
*   Fail: The job failed.
*   Cancelled: The job is canceled.
*   all (default)

title.zh: 查询回收站中的任务列表

descriptions.zh:
- 仅通用型NAS文件系统支持该功能。
- 最多可以查询最近执行的50个任务。
descriptions.en:
*   Only General-purpose NAS file systems support this operation.
*   You can query a maximum of 50 jobs that are recently executed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas list-recycle-bin-jobs --file-system-id 1ca4040000 --job-id rb-150000ed-r-162500002441 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --status All --region cn-hangzhou
